value.rationale: Closes a concrete open logarithmic-vs-linear variance alternative for temporal local observations of noisy voter dynamics, with an explicit degree-and-noise constant valid on infinite locally finite graphs. The local refresh barrier also establishes the published CLT variance condition without time thinning.

final_claim: In synchronous binary noisy voting on any connected locally finite graph with positive degree Δ at observed vertex u, refreshing independently with probability 0<ε<1, the lag-d equality count Q_T has Var(Q_T)≥(ε^{Δ+4}/2)[1+floor((T−d−1)/(2d+2))], for d≥1,T≥d+1. In particular the variance is uniformly positive linear in T, ruling out the logarithmic branch of Benjamini–Helman Tov–Zhukovskii and implying their unthinned CLT under their initially independent fair law.
